title: Palindrome Checker
description: Return true if the given string is a palindrome. Otherwise, return false, ignoring punctuation, case, and spacing.

title: DNA Pairing
description: The DNA strand is missing the pairing element. Take each character, get its pair, and return the results as a 2d array.

title: Find the Missing Letter
description: Find the missing letter in the passed letter range and return it. If all letters are present in the range, return undefined.

title: Chunky Monkey
description: Write a function that splits an array (first argument) into groups the length of size (second argument) and returns them as a two-dimensional array.

title: Falsy Bouncer
description: Remove all falsy values from an array. Falsy values in JavaScript are false, null, 0, "", undefined, and NaN.

title: HTML Entities Converter
description: Convert the characters &, <, >, ", and ' to their corresponding HTML entities.

title: Largest Numbers in Arrays
description: Return an array consisting of the largest number from each provided sub-array.

title: Mutation Checker
description: Return true if the string in the first element of the array contains all of the letters of the string in the second element of the array.

title: Reverse a String
description: Reverse the provided string and return the reversed string.

title: Finders Keepers
description: Create a function that looks through an array and returns the first element in it that passes a truth test.

title: Sum All Numbers in a Range
description: We'll pass you an array of two numbers. Return the sum of those two numbers plus the sum of all the numbers between them.

title: Sorted Union
description: Write a function that takes two or more arrays and returns a new array of unique values in the order of the original provided arrays.

title: Title Case a Sentence
description: Return the provided string with the first letter of each word capitalized. Make sure the rest of the word is in lower case.

title: Slice and Splice
description: Copy each element of the first array into the second array, in order, beginning at the specified index index.

title: Find the Longest Word in a String
description: Return the length of the longest word in the provided sentence.
